# after

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/after>

- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen AFTER: this event begins strictly after the related event ends; the transitive inverse of [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md). (= [time:intervalAfter](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalAfter); TimeML AFTER; TEO after.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order two events when one begins strictly after the other ends — the Allen AFTER link, the inverse view of [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when the events abut ([`gmeow:metBy`](gmeow-metBy.md)) or overlap ([`gmeow:overlappedBy`](gmeow-overlappedBy.md)), or when crisp dates already fix the order; prefer asserting [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md) and reading this as its inverse.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:before`](gmeow-before.md) in the natural direction and read [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md) as its transitive inverse; the sound transitive closure is derived, the full Allen table stays in the solver (P12).

### Examples

- ex:concert [`gmeow:after`](gmeow-after.md) ex:dinner.
